name: Visitors can browse use cases and how it works

planSteps.description: Click Use cases in the main navigation.
The URL path is /use-cases and the page displays use case content.
Open one use case detail from the list.
The URL is /use-cases/ followed by a use case slug, and a heading and use case description are visible.
Click How it works in the main navigation.
The URL path is /how-it-works and explanatory content is visible.
